payload.rationale: The packet excerpts show Report-type monitoring for Flow, Total Dissolved Solids, and Daphnia pulex (WET), which is suggestive of report-only limits rather than numeric effluent-limit exceedance comparison, but the obligation bundles five distinct parameters and the burden for a non-UNRESOLVED disposition is not met for the set as a whole. The TDS row does not ground which columns correspond separately to TDS discharge versus TDS intake, so those two referents cannot be adjudicated independently from this packet. No excerpt identifies or characterizes any named Report toxics parameter or its limit type. Without establishing applicability for every parameter in the obligation values—and without converting absence of excerpts into closed-world REJECT—neither ACCEPT nor REJECT is sufficiently grounded; UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
